options.text: To automate the integration of code changes.
To deploy code to production only.

questions.explanation: CI pipelines automate the integration and testing of code changes, improving efficiency.

questions.question: Which tool is commonly used for CI/CD?

questions.question: Complete the snippet to define a job in GitHub Actions:
questions.code_template:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ____
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
